steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation and avoid the publish restriction.
Set the single-stage event type to RFP.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Choose the available questionnaire template for the RFP.
a product is needed before participants or publishing
Complete the required questionnaire content so the technical event can be published.
Assign the required evaluator for the technical event.

args.goal: On the single-stage RFP create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", leave both clause modes as None, leave "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory" unticked, and click Done; stop when the create screen is visible again.

steps.note: Configure the requested optional terms using the on-screen flow because no domain step exposes clause creation or mandatory-mode state.
Add one QA test vendor to the event.
Commit the required 30-minute schedule.
Publish the completed single-stage RFP.
Confirm that the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's RFP questionnaire in the vendor portal.
Verify that the first optional clause is visible to the vendor.
Verify that the second optional clause is visible to the vendor.
Return to the buyer session before submitting the vendor response through the supported vendor-bid flow.
Have the invited vendor submit its technical response without requiring a bid price.
Confirm that the vendor submission was accepted.
Verify that the buyer sees at least one response on the technical stage.
